themes.label: Mortgage rate and amortisation
themes.definition: Rate changes, rate discounts (ränterabatt), fixing periods (bindningstid), amortisation requirements.

themes.label: Funds and investments (Robur, ISK)
themes.definition: Funds, ISK, fund fees, investment accounts and trading in the app.

themes.label: Where customers praise us: quick, easy app journeys
themes.definition: Positive app reviews: easy, fast, useful, smooth.

themes.label: New app and update experience
themes.definition: Reactions to a new app version: changes, missing features, old app better.

themes.label: App login and BankID
themes.definition: Cannot log in; BankID or Mobilt BankID, passcode, biometrics, early sign-out.

themes.label: App features and usability
themes.definition: Missing features, confusing design, statements in the app, accessibility.

themes.label: App outages, speed and crashes
themes.definition: App is slow, will not open, freezes, crashes or shows an error.

themes.label: Could not get through
themes.definition: Cannot reach customer service (kundtjänst), long phone queues, message function removed, unhelpful replies.

themes.label: Branch (kontor) service
themes.definition: Branch (kontor) visits, staff behaviour, being sent elsewhere.

themes.label: Clear information and fair treatment (FI focus area)
themes.definition: Unclear information, unfair treatment, customers in a vulnerable situation, access to a payment account.

themes.label: General dissatisfaction
themes.definition: Negative without a specific issue: 'worst bank', 'awful service'.

themes.label: Card benefits, cashback and lounge access
themes.definition: Card benefits, cashback, insurance and lounge access, and changes to them.

themes.label: Product questions and advice-seeking
themes.definition: Neutral questions and comparisons: which account, is it worth it.

themes.label: Account measures: frozen or restricted accounts
themes.definition: Accounts, cards, BankID or payments blocked or restricted under anti-money-laundering or fraud rules; reviews and holds.

themes.label: Loan and mortgage applications
themes.definition: Applications, loan promises (lånelöfte), credit checks, payout delays, documents.

themes.label: Account opening and switching bank (byta bank)
themes.definition: Opening an account, moving to the bank from another bank, BankID for newcomers.

themes.label: Know-your-customer questions and identity checks
themes.definition: Questions about income, purpose and origin of money; ID and passport checks; address or phone changes.

themes.label: Account charges and fees
themes.definition: Package fees (for example nyckelkund), account charges, unexpected deductions.

themes.label: Mis-selling and add-on products
themes.definition: Products or packages added without consent, sales pressure, misleading claims.

themes.label: Praise for service
themes.definition: Customers praising staff, resolution or the bank overall.

themes.label: Other
themes.definition: Anything that fits no theme above.

themes.label: Card applications and identity checks
themes.definition: Applications declined, stuck in checks, documents asked for again.

themes.label: Card interest and charges
themes.definition: Interest, annual fees, late fees and foreign-use charges on cards.

themes.label: Swish, Bankgiro and payment failures
themes.definition: Swish, Bankgiro or transfers failing, pending or held.

themes.label: Internet bank
themes.definition: Internet bank access, errors, removed functions and downtime.

themes.label: Branch (kontor) closures and access
themes.definition: Branch closing, nearest open branch far away, short opening hours, cash services.

themes.label: Share price, results and corporate news
themes.definition: Results, share price and leadership news; not customer experience.

themes.label: Other group companies
themes.definition: Swedbank Pay, Sparbankerna, Baltic Banking and other group companies (outside retail figures).
